title: Claude Agent SDK — The Agent Loop, Tools and Permissions
titleKn: Claude Agent SDK — Agent Loop, Tools, ಅನುಮತಿಗಳು
desc: The loop behind a coding-style agent, built-in and custom tools, and how permission modes control what it may do.
objectives: Describe the gather, act, verify loop.
Explain why least privilege matters for agents that act on files.
objectivesKn: ಫೈಲ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವ agents ಗೆ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಹಕ್ಕು ಏಕೆ ಮುಖ್ಯ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

title: Claude Agent SDK — Subagents, Hooks and Sessions
titleKn: Claude Agent SDK — Subagents, Hooks, Sessions
desc: How subagents isolate context, how hooks add deterministic control points, and how sessions persist a conversation.
objectives: Explain subagents as isolated contexts with their own tools.
Describe hooks that run at fixed events.
objectivesKn: subagents ಅನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ context ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

[{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Claude Agent SDK — Subagents, Hooks and Sessions","textKn":"Claude Agent SDK — Subagents, Hooks and Sessions","level":"H1"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Lesson Info","headingKn":"Lesson ಮಾಹಿತಿ","bodyEn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 minutes · Part 2 of 3 in Claude Agent SDK: Subagents and Session Store","bodyKn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳು · Part 2 of 3"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Subagents Isolate Context","headingKn":"Subagents Context ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕಿಸುತ್ತವೆ","bodyEn":"A subagent gets its own fresh context, instructions and tool set for a focused task, such as searching a large codebase, and returns only a short result. The main conversation stays uncluttered.","bodyKn":"subagent ಗೆ ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಕೃತ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ತನ್ನದೇ ಹೊಸ context, ಸೂಚನೆ, tool ಸೆಟ್ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಣ್ಣ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಮಾತ್ರ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮುಖ್ಯ ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆ ಗೊಂದಲವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Hooks Are Deterministic","headingKn":"Hooks ನಿರ್ಧಾರಾತ್ಮಕ","bodyEn":"Hooks run your code at fixed points such as before a tool call or after an edit. Unlike instructions the model may ignore, a hook always runs, so it suits rules that must hold every time.","bodyKn":"hooks ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು tool ಕರೆ ಮೊದಲು, ತಿದ್ದಿದ ನಂತರ ಮುಂತಾದ ನಿಗದಿತ ಸ್ಥಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಮಾದರಿ ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳಂತಲ್ಲ, hook ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Sessions and Resumption","headingKn":"Sessions ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದುವರಿಕೆ","bodyEn":"Sessions store the conversation so a later call can resume it. Plan where the store lives, how long it is kept and how to fork or discard a session.","bodyKn":"sessions ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆ ಉಳಿಸಿ ನಂತರದ ಕರೆ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಬಿಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಂಗ್ರಹ ಎಲ್ಲಿ, ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಾಲ, fork ಅಥವಾ ತ್ಯಜಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ ಎಂದು ಯೋಜಿಸಿ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Delegation Has a Cost","headingKn":"ವಹಿಸುವಿಕೆಗೆ ವೆಚ್ಚ","bodyEn":"Each subagent runs its own model calls. Use them when isolation or parallel work saves more than it costs, not for trivial steps.","bodyKn":"ಪ್ರತಿ subagent ತನ್ನದೇ ಮಾದರಿ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ ಕೆಲಸ ವೆಚ್ಚಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಉಳಿಸಿದಾಗ ಬಳಸಿ, ಸರಳ ಹಂತಗಳಿಗಲ್ಲ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Key Takeaways","headingKn":"ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳು","bodyEn":"• Subagents keep the main context clean.
• Hooks always run; instructions may not.
• Plan session storage and retention.","bodyKn":"• subagents ಮುಖ್ಯ context ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ.
• hooks ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
• session ಸಂಗ್ರಹ ಯೋಜಿಸಿ."}},{"type":"quiz","data":{"questions":[{"q":"Why use a subagent?","qKn":"subagent ಏಕೆ?","opts":["Isolated context for a focused task","To avoid tools","To increase context","To remove the main agent"],"optsKn":["ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಕೃತ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ context","tools ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲು","context ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲು","ಮುಖ್ಯ agent ತೆಗೆಯಲು"],"correct":0},{"q":"How do hooks differ from instructions?","qKn":"hooks ಮತ್ತು ಸೂಚನೆಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ?","opts":["Hooks always run at their event","Hooks are optional to the model","Hooks are prompts","No difference"],"optsKn":["hooks ಘಟನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ","ಮಾದರಿಗೆ ಐಚ್ಛಿಕ","ಅವು prompts","ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಇಲ್ಲ"],"correct":0},{"q":"Is delegation free?","qKn":"ವಹಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಉಚಿತವೇ?","opts":["No: each subagent makes its own model calls","Yes","Only for hooks","Only in tests"],"optsKn":["ಇಲ್ಲ: ಪ್ರತಿ subagent ಮಾದರಿ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ","ಹೌದು","hooks ಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ","ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ"],"correct":0}]}}]

title: Claude Agent SDK — Building Reliable Agents: Sandboxing, Evaluation and Cost
titleKn: Claude Agent SDK — ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹ Agents ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ: Sandbox, ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ, ವೆಚ್ಚ
desc: Running an acting agent safely and measuring it: isolation, evaluation loops and cost control.
objectives: Explain why an agent that runs commands needs a sandbox.
Design an evaluation loop for an agent.
Control cost with budgets and context management.
objectivesKn: ಆದೇಶ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುವ agent ಗೆ sandbox ಏಕೆ ಬೇಕು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
